info.title: Niu Platform & Provider Administration API
info.description:
Model inference and management APIs for Niu. Browse the resource groups in the sidebar,
search by operation or path, and expand the request and response schemas for exact fields.

## Getting started
Use the [HTTP quickstart](/help/guides/api-quickstart/) for your first model request,
or the [JavaScript SDK guide](/help/guides/sdk-quickstart/) for typed clients.
[Download the complete OpenAPI 3.1 document](/docs/openapi/public.json).

## Authentication and scope
Inference uses a workspace API key. Management operations require the member session,
platform authority or Provider membership stated by that operation. These credentials
are not interchangeable. See each operation's security scheme and access description.
Legacy `project` path segments refer to workspaces; legacy `provider` paths refer to Providers.

## Requests and responses
Send the documented Content-Type and use the declared request schema. Response status codes,
error bodies and pagination fields are operation-specific. Follow the returned cursor rather
than assuming a list is complete. Streaming operations document their event format separately.

Monetary amounts and large counters use the exact string representation in their schemas.
Preserve currency and rate units; Provider purchase rates and customer charges are separate.

## Writes and retries
Where an operation documents an idempotency key, retry an uncertain outcome with the same
key and identical input. Preserve expected revisions for configuration updates; reload after
a conflict. A timeout does not prove that a write or an upstream generation did not execute.
Read the individual operation's retry and reconciliation behavior before resubmitting.

get.summary: Preview a Credits purchase reversal and read committed reversal receipts
get.description: Platform administration required. Evaluates the unoccupied (unconsumed, unreserved and unreversed) ranges of an original Credits purchase lot and computes the exact processor-representable refund amount (whole minor units of 10000000 nanounits), the reversible atom prefix and any residual atoms or monetary backing that cannot be represented at processor precision without discarding value. Also returns all previously committed reversal receipts on the order. Consumed ranges require an explicit charge refund before they become reversible. Does not mutate state or execute an external payment refund.

parameters.name: credit_atoms
parameters.description: Optional target unoccupied atom prefix to evaluate; defaults to all currently available unoccupied atoms on the purchase lot.

post.summary: Reverse unoccupied Credits purchase ranges at processor minor-unit precision
post.description: Platform administration required. Records an immutable reversal of unoccupied ranges belonging to an original Credits purchase lot. The requested atom quantity must map to a positive whole minor-unit payment refund (divisible by 10000000 nanounits) with zero discarded residual atoms or backing. Simulated purchases preserve zero cash backing and never enter verified cash funding reversals. Identical idempotent replay returns the original receipt even after later charges, reversals or rule changes; conflicting reuse returns 409. Recording a reversal does not execute an external payment-processor transfer.

post.summary: Publish a versioned Credits text consumption tariff
post.description: Platform administration required and rechecked transactionally for operators. Publish atom-denominated rates independently of purchase conversion and monetary tariffs. New publication requires the current unit definition and installation revision. Concurrent stale writes conflict. Equal idempotent retries return their original normalized publication, even after later price or unit changes; changed input conflicts. Rates and quantity thresholds use exact decimal strings; context thresholds are unique and normalized in ascending order. Nullable category rates use ordinary rates, never inherit another tier. Rates are per million tokens, rounded upward once after adding applicable exact token products. Add the fixed request fee, then apply the minimum charge. Explicit zero is valid; absence of a publication is unavailable. Publishing a tariff does not activate billing mode, issue Credits, convert money balances, admit requests or change prior request bindings.

post.summary: Issue noncash Credits with an immutable provenance and expiry
post.description: Platform administration required. New issuance requires active Credits mode and the current unit definition. Promotional and simulated grants have zero monetary backing and create neither a payment receipt nor a monetary balance entry. Provide a customer-appropriate reason. Expiry is optional and must be in the future when new issuance commits. Reusing an idempotency key with the same semantic input returns the original grant without extending expiry, even after expiry or later unit publications. Different input conflicts. The returned amount is original issuance, not current spendable capacity. Purchased provenance is reserved for independently verified payments. Operator authority is rechecked under a transaction lock.

put.summary: Publish a preview-confirmed installation billing mode
put.description: Platform administration required and rechecked under lock. Requires an unexpired originally compatible saved preview, its matching current revision and a distinct target mode. Rechecks customer obligations atomically while holding financial-table locks. Concurrent financial activity returns a retryable 409; re-read compatibility if state changed. Balances, prices, monetary limits and historical records are never converted. A successful publication creates an immutable change receipt and advances the installation revision once. Identical idempotent retry returns the original receipt even after subsequent mode changes; it does not reapply the old mode. Mode activation alone does not establish configured unit prices, compatible spending limits, model availability or media readiness. Existing monetary limits require explicit compatible configuration before affected Credits admission. New monetary grants/funding require currency mode and new unit issuance requires Credits mode.

get.summary: Preview installation billing-mode incompatibilities
get.description: Platform administration required. One current database statement reports incompatible customer balances, credit facilities, pending checkouts, unposted charges, unresolved customer requests and reservations, unapplied monetary grant intents and remaining unexpired Credits. Enabling Credits additionally requires a unit definition and matching platform-currency purchase rule. Each category includes complete counts and at most 100 affected company accounts, with explicit truncation. Original tariffs and monetary limits are retained and summarized, never converted. Existing monetary limits still require explicit compatible Credits configuration before those workspaces or keys can spend Credits. This is advisory only: blockers_empty does not activate billing mode, prove route readiness or authorize a later switch. Any mode publication must revalidate current state atomically. Reads never modify accounts or history. Same-mode previews still report current incompatibilities. No procurement amounts or credentials are included. Internal account identifiers are routing references, not display labels.

post.summary: Supplement missing native request usage from captured OpenRouter evidence
post.description: Installation write access only. Empty object input; no client-supplied generation identifier, quantities or costs. Uses the stored server response reference and original managed credential only while its vendor revision remains current and enabled. New captured references pin the dispatched upstream model independently of later mapping edits; legacy references without that binding still require the unchanged enabled model revision. Exact upstream model match required; aliases are not inferred equivalent. Bounded metadata lookup can return 502 while metadata is unavailable. Eligible requests have unknown aggregate usage, or confirmed provider-reported totals with missing cache-read/reasoning quantities and no recorded monetary or Credits customer charge. For known totals, metadata must match both totals and every reported known category, and add at least one previously missing category. Cache-write quantities are not supplied by this lookup; existing quantities are preserved. Canonical metadata must confirm not-cancelled execution with stop/length/tool_calls and an exact model/reference match. Cancelled or nonterminal metadata remains unresolved. Atomically retains the original execution/usage/category state and immutable supplemental terminal evidence, then marks execution confirmed-completed. Existing completion timestamps are preserved; absent timestamps record the time confirmation is stored. Original failure and delivery timing remain unchanged. Recorded does not mean settled: existing financial recovery applies the request-bound tariffs; missing required categories keep liability unresolved. Never resubmits inference. Identical replay returns the saved receipt without upstream access. Cache-Control no-store. New v2 receipts retain terminal finish/cancellation evidence. Legacy v1 receipts retain null terminal fields without invented backfill. The server resolves the organization from the authorized workspace. Foreign or missing workspaces return 404. The compatibility route remains supported with identical payload, owner, revision and replay semantics.

200.description: Supplemental usage recorded; settlement may remain pending.

upstream_finish_reason.description: Null for legacy v1 receipts; never backfilled.

upstream_cancelled.description: Explicit false for v2 terminal evidence; null for legacy v1 receipts.

409.description: Ineligible completion, changed route or conflicting evidence. usage_reconciliation_identity_mismatch means upstream model/reference identity differs from captured request evidence; identities are not exposed. usage_reconciliation_incomplete means matching provider metadata does not confirm a non-cancelled terminal generation. Usage and charges remain unresolved in both cases.

502.description: Upstream metadata unavailable, refused, malformed, oversized or timed out.

503.description: Storage or credential decryption unavailable, including a bounded record-lock or statement timeout. A failed recording transaction preserves prior usage and leaves no partial receipt; retry does not resubmit inference.

handler_operations_json_VideoChoiceContr.description: Values are canonical names of at most 256 UTF-8 bytes; any default must be one of them.

handler_operations_json_VideoOutputSchem.description: Optional effective output mapping for this schema revision. Requires resolution, ratio and positive duration controls, each with a default or required input. Pixel estimation additionally requires a positive frames_per_second control; seconds estimation may omit it. Missing resolution/ratio combinations reject requests before dispatch. Estimates never establish reported usage or maximum liability. The ark-direct-v1 adapter qualifies video_tokens only; openrouter-video-v1 supports owner-funded text generation with seconds estimates and unknown reported quantity.

estimator_revision.description: Reviewed configuration reference; at most 256 UTF-8 bytes.

resolution.description: Must be accepted by the configured resolution control.

ratio.description: Must be accepted by the configured ratio control; each resolution/ratio pair is unique.

cursor.description: Internal continuation reference; never a product label.

input_detectors.description: Required input detectors. Composes workspace and assigned-key restrictions. Only deployment-authorized workspaces and declared unmetered services can activate a current configuration fingerprint. Matched or indeterminate results fail closed before inference admission. Textual content only, after local redaction; unsupported content is denied. Paid and unknown-cost detectors remain synthetic-only.

input_rules.description: Local text rules enforced before dispatch. Workspace and assigned-key rules compose; unsupported content fails closed. At most 32 combined rules are supported.

output.description: Complete textual output inspection bounded to 1 MiB. Streaming, tools, structured-output requests and Embeddings are incompatible and rejected before inference in both modes. Buffered enforcement withholds indeterminate output; observation records matches or indeterminate coverage without redaction or denial. Observation sees the original response and cannot weaken inherited enforcement. Incurred usage remains chargeable. External output detectors and streaming inspection are not implemented.

guardrails_openapi_yaml_AccessRule.description: Empty allowlists deny. Values must be exact, nonblank, trimmed identifiers without controls or wildcard; use allow_all explicitly.

request.description: Captured JSON request with known credential fields removed.

response.description: Sanitized retained output; empty when response_omitted is true.

response_omitted.description: True when truncated JSON cannot be safely parsed and its response body is withheld. Request content remains available.

endpoint.description: HTTPS gateway base or complete submit.php endpoint. A base path gets /submit.php appended; a supplied submit.php is preserved, including subdirectories. Trailing slashes are normalized. Query strings, fragments and URL credentials are rejected. The complete encoded checkout must fit 2048 bytes for the largest supported order and amount; invalid enabled configuration is rejected before persistence. Existing saved checkout URLs are not rewritten.

methods.description: Saved methods or deployment defaults; legacy disabled configurations may contain unsupported values. Writes accept only alipay and wxpay.

response_format.description: Buffered and streamed structured JSON are supported on explicitly enabled priced text routes. Serialized response-format instructions count toward the route input byte guard alongside messages; this guard is not a provider tokenizer or a guarantee against reported overruns.

reasoning.description: Priced Chat supports explicit reasoning budgets on OpenRouter routes. max_tokens must be a positive integer strictly below the total output limit; it is a subset of that limit. exclude controls whether upstream reasoning text is requested in the response. Other reasoning options on priced routes are rejected. Model support remains upstream-specific.

content.description: Usually text or null for a function call; extensions remain provider-specific.

arguments.description: JSON-encoded function arguments; Niu does not execute the function.

usage.description: Optional provider token usage. Its presence alone does not guarantee complete valid accounting evidence. Customer charges must be read from billing APIs, never inferred from missing counters.

handler_operations_json_ChatCompletionRe.description: Nonstreaming completion envelope. Provider extension fields may be present. Missing usage is unknown, not zero.

owner_funded.description: Configuration-list metadata identifying a private credential owned by one account. Not accepted in configuration writes.

supplier.description: Provider ownership on configuration-list reads; credentials and commercial data are excluded.

api_base.description: HTTPS endpoint or HTTP loopback endpoint without URL credentials or query parameters.

supplier_id.description: Existing Provider business to own this API-key configuration. Mutually exclusive with create_supplier=true; ownership and creation commit atomically.

create_supplier.description: Atomically create a Provider business with this name and its explicit configuration ownership link. Omission preserves legacy configuration-only creation.

api_key.description: Omit to retain the current credential.

available.description: Configuration eligibility in the management list; not an upstream health or entitlement check.

owner_funded.description: Management-list metadata identifying private owner-funded routes. Omitted from configuration writes.

provider_assets.description: Explicit FastRouter asset protocol on an Ark adapter; not processing readiness or commercial qualification.

supports_generate_content.description: Native GenerateContent opt-in for static or managed gemini routes; does not imply streaming, tools or media support.

supports_messages_streaming_tools.description: Explicit native client-tool SSE capability; requires supports_messages_tools and supports_messages_streaming. JSON arguments are bounded and validated at block completion.

supports_messages_tools.description: Explicit buffered native client-tool capability; requires supports_messages. Streaming tools require the separate supports_messages_streaming_tools capability.

supports_messages_streaming.description: Explicit native text SSE opt-in; requires supports_messages.

supports_messages.description: Explicit native Messages nonstreaming text capability for OpenRouter or Anthropic routes. Does not imply streaming, tools or media support.

handler_operations_json_CatalogMetadata.description: Descriptive provider metadata, stored under capabilities.catalog on vendor mappings and exposed as catalog on model listings. Advertised USD per-token prices are separate from billing rates. Missing values mean unknown, never zero.

handler_operations_json_VideoSchema.description: Versioned constraints for the exact alias/upstream model/channel. The enclosing capabilities document is limited to 16 KiB. Backend validation enforces relative bounds, defaults, input transport, roles and incompatible controls. Configuration does not qualify a route or enable unsupported media/callback transport.

revision.description: Trimmed canonical revision with no control characters; at most 256 UTF-8 bytes.

model_alias.description: Must match the enclosing model alias.

upstream_model.description: Must match the enclosing upstream mapping.

channel.description: Exact canonical channel contract; at most 256 UTF-8 bytes.

required_controls.description: Every named control must be configured.

exclusive_controls.description: Each pair names distinct configured controls; both cannot have defaults.

callbacks_qualified.description: Required for a callback_url declaration; separate adapter/offer qualification and callback authentication still apply.

handler_operations_json_VideoInputRule.description: Item/count bounds cannot exceed the enclosing request limits. Non-text inputs require HTTPS or at least one allowed Base64 MIME type; required roles need at least one allowed role. Names are trimmed, control-free and limited to 256 UTF-8 bytes.

slug_aliases.description: Previously issued slugs accepted for existing bookmarks.

organization_id.description: Company scope. Members default to their current company. Installation callers may omit it to create a Personal workspace company.

spending_limit.description: Optional lifetime retail cap in an existing company account currency. Requires an owner or installation administrator. Saved atomically with the workspace; omitted means no limit.

handler_operations_json_KeyInput.description: Unknown fields are rejected. Configure per-key customer spending, IP allowlist, rolling request rate, token budgets and concurrent-request limits through their separate key management APIs. Key creation does not set these policies. Workspace and company financial limits still apply; rotation preserves the key lineage policies.

allowed_models.description: Deprecated. Omit to grant every model available to this workspace; explicit aliases are retained for compatibility. The wildcard must be the only entry when used.

ttl_seconds.description: Required. Integer 1 to 31536000 sets a finite lifetime; explicit null creates a key without automatic expiration. Missing, zero or negative values are rejected. Revocation and all lineage limits still apply.

token.description: One-time workspace API key secret; store securely. Never present in key metadata reads.

handler_operations_json_ApiErrorResponse.description: Gateway application error envelope. This does not describe framework body/path parsing failures or a proxy-generated response. Branch on error.type and HTTP status rather than matching message text.

message.description: Safe human-readable explanation; not a stable programmatic identifier.

type.description: Machine-readable failure category; new categories may be added.

code.description: HTTP status code, not a separate application error number.

expires_at_ms.description: Unix milliseconds for finite expiration. Null means no automatic expiration, not an invalid or unknown timestamp. Rotation preserves this state.

last_used_at_ms.description: Latest durable dispatch intent in Unix milliseconds. Null means no attributed dispatch is recorded, not that the credential was never authenticated. Rotation preserves the old key's history; its replacement starts without a dispatch record.

context_label.description: Meaningful current model/adapter/channel label. Contains no account identifiers.

human_verification.description: Supports explicit private H5 verification operations, not proof of human completion or permission to mutate.

next_cursor.description: Present when limit or after selects paging. Null ends the directory.

remaining_nanos.description: Remaining customer allowance in currency nanounits; null when unlimited.
